pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Routing key of the binding, or a list of routing keys to bind with one by one

url.title: URl
url.description: RabbitMQ connection URL. Connection parameters such as heartbeat, frameMax and channelMax can be given as query parameters

socketOptions.title: Socket Options
socketOptions.description: Options passed to amqplib's connect as socket options, for example the TLS options (ca, cert, key, passphrase, servername, rejectUnauthorized), timeout, or clientProperties

ca.title: CA
ca.description: Trusted CA certificates in PEM format

cert.title: Certificate
cert.description: Client certificate chain in PEM format

key.title: Key
key.description: Client private key in PEM format

passphrase.title: Passphrase
passphrase.description: Passphrase of the client private key

servername.title: Server Name
servername.description: Server name for the SNI and the certificate verification

rejectUnauthorized.title: Reject Unauthorized
rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject the server if its certificate can not be verified

clientProperties.title: Client Properties
clientProperties.description: Properties sent to the broker, such as connection_name, which is shown in the management UI

exchange.title: Exchange
exchange.description: Exchange to declare and bind the queue to

type.title: Type
type.description: Exchange type, including the ones provided by plugins

internal.title: Internal
internal.description: Exchange that can not be published to directly, only through bindings from other exchanges

autoDelete.title: Auto Delete
autoDelete.description: Delete the exchange when it is no longer bound to anything

alternateExchange.title: Alternate Exchange
alternateExchange.description: Exchange that receives the messages this exchange can not route

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Additional arguments of the exchange declaration, such as x-delayed-type

passive.title: Passive
passive.description: Only check that the exchange exists instead of declaring it. Useful for an exchange that is declared elsewhere with other settings

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Routing key of the binding, or a list of routing keys to bind with one by one

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Binding arguments, used to match the headers of the messages for an exchange of type headers

bindings.title: Bindings
bindings.description: Additional bindings of the queue to existing exchanges

exchange.title: Exchange
exchange.description: Name of the exchange to bind the queue to

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Binding arguments, such as the headers to match for an exchange of type headers

exchangeBindings.title: Exchange Bindings
exchangeBindings.description: Bindings between existing exchanges, so a message published to the source is routed to the destination as well

source.title: Source
source.description: Name of the exchange the messages come from

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Name of the exchange the messages are routed to

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Binding arguments, such as the headers to match for an exchange of type headers

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: Queue to declare and consume messages from

name.title: Name
name.description: Queue name. An empty name lets the broker generate one

autoDelete.title: Auto Delete
autoDelete.description: Delete the queue when its last consumer goes away

messageTtl.title: Message TTL
messageTtl.description: Time in milliseconds after which a message in the queue expires

expires.title: Expires
expires.description: Time in milliseconds the queue can stay unused before it is deleted

deadLetterExchange.title: Dead Letter Exchange
deadLetterExchange.description: Exchange that receives the messages that are rejected, expired or dropped from the queue

deadLetterRoutingKey.title: Dead Letter Routing Key
deadLetterRoutingKey.description: Routing key the dead lettered messages are published with

maxLength.title: Max Length
maxLength.description: Maximum number of messages in the queue

maxPriority.title: Max Priority
maxPriority.description: Maximum priority the messages of the queue can have

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Additional arguments of the queue declaration, such as x-queue-type, x-delivery-limit or x-overflow

passive.title: Passive
passive.description: Only check that the queue exists instead of declaring it. Useful for a queue that is declared elsewhere with other settings

prefetch.title: Prefetch
prefetch.description: Number of unacknowledged messages the broker delivers at once

prefetchGlobal.title: Prefetch Global
prefetchGlobal.description: Apply the prefetch limit to the whole channel instead of each consumer

consumerTag.title: Consumer Tag
consumerTag.description: Identifier of the consumer, generated by the broker if omitted

exclusive.title: Exclusive
exclusive.description: Do not let other consumers consume from the queue

noLocal.title: No Local
noLocal.description: Do not deliver the messages published on the same connection

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Additional arguments of the consumer, such as x-stream-offset for streams

noAck.title: No Acknowledgement
noAck.description: The broker considers a message acknowledged as soon as it is delivered. Turn it off to acknowledge messages from the function with channel.ack and channel.nack
